annotations: @Tool(name = "conversation_search", description = "Search the earlier conversation of this session for messages that contain the given "+"keywords, ignoring case. It also finds messages that are no longer in your context. Returns "+"one page of matches, oldest first, as JSON: 'results' with the timestamp, the type and the "+"text of each message, and 'nextPage' when more matches may follow. A long text is cut to "+"an excerpt around the keyword.")
parameters: @ToolParam(description = "One or more keywords, separated by commas. Each keyword is matched as literal text, so 'invoice, refund' looks for two words and 'invoice refund' for that exact phrase.") String query
@ToolParam(description = "'any' (the default): a message matches when it contains one of the keywords. 'all': it must contain every keyword.", required = false) @Nullable String match
@ToolParam(description = "The page of matches, starting at 0. Omit it for the first page.", required = false) @Nullable Integer page

members.name: toolSearchTool
annotations:
@Tool(name = "toolSearchTool", description = """
			Search for tools in the tool registry to discover capabilities for completing the current task.
			Use this when you need functionality not provided by your currently available tools.
			The search queries against tool names, descriptions, and parameter information to find the most relevant tools.
			Returns references to matching tools which will be expanded into full definitions you can then invoke.
			""")
parameters: @ToolParam(description = "A natural language search query describing the tool capability you need. Be specific and include relevant keywords.") String query
@ToolParam(description = "Maximum number of tool references to return (1-10). Default is 5.", required = false) Integer maxResults
@ToolParam(description = "Optional filter to narrow search to a specific tool category.", required = false) String categoryFilter
